projection_rules.research_fact: VIN-selected model platform with immutable route

projection_rules.runtime_projection: no cross-marque inheritance without identity evidence

actions: Apply only exact published VDS hypotheses or generation-qualified model facts.
Keep unmatched and ambiguous vehicles on trusted-map behavior only.
Add only routes belonging to the selected model platform.
Do not sweep sibling E-GMP model candidates.
Read preferred ISO identity before proprietary candidates.
Preserve unreadable identity as an outcome.
Read candidates only after route response.
Preserve raw payload and negative response separately.
Keep decoder output a hypothesis until guided validation.
Stop on safety, budget, cancellation or low information gain.
For GV60, stop after trusted behavior because no model-specific research route is authorized.

priority_model: exact platform + immutable source + reached route + user value - traffic cost - ambiguity
brand_specific_priority: battery and chassis signals with independent references
